test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

The doctor had to go with operation as Raj’s condition was very _________ (comical).
solution:
The correct answer is: **'Option 1: serious'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word 'comical' (हास्यप्रद) refers to something that is intended to be humorous or funny. 

 
 
• **For example:** "The play was a comical take on modern society."
 
 
 
• 'Serious' (गंभीर), the correct antonym, refers to something grave, important or significant. 
 
 
• **Example sentence:** "His comments raised serious concerns about the project."
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is **'Option 1: serious'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Prone'** (प्रवृत्त) often refers to a tendency or inclination towards something.
 
• **'Curious' **(उत्सुक) means eager to know or learn something.
 
• **'Peculiar'** (विचित्र) means strange or odd; unusual.
